about: Default plan, in order of value. Edit freely: steps already complete are skipped, so renaming a step to match a run you already have reuses it. Controls and repeats use the development split only, to save usage; the held-out variants are run once, at the end, for the final comparison. The decomposed arms (decision 141) run with the reference model and effort, two reviews at a time (each review runs up to REVIEW_CONCURRENCY=4 rule workers); the -raw steps skip the consolidator, to show what it adds. 10 October (local): the single-call repeats started that morning are reused by name (opus55-medium-r1..r3, sonnet55-medium-r1..r3, opus5-medium); resuming fills in the development variants they lack (the bundle) and retries their failures. Concurrency 2 everywhere, to go easier on the usage limit. 10 October (user: "maybe per-rule opus agents is overkill... try a limited pilot of per rule opus, then per rule sonnet/haiku in a way that complements the single opus call"): the full per-rule and agent repeats are replaced by a one-run pilot on ten development bundle variants: per-rule Opus single calls, and two hybrids (the single Opus call plus per-rule Sonnet or Haiku checkers that add findings only where Opus flagged nothing). One review at a time, since each fans out to ~19 calls. Revised the same afternoon (user: "one opus agent should be the minimum, with perhaps single calls to sonnet and haiku to complement"; "per rule opus single calls is probably not the one"): the pilot is one Opus review agent (whole agreement plus read/search/define/resolve tools, up to 8 replies), and that agent plus per-rule Sonnet or Haiku checker calls. Per-rule Opus and the single-call hybrids are not run. Trimmed for time (user: "12 hours?? really"; "i want to keep the alternate models"): controls and low effort on the 34 development agreement variants only, the scrambled-ids control dropped, the pilot on six bundle variants (clean copy, three markups, one length-paired plant, one harmless edit) at two reviews at a time; the Sonnet 5.5 and Opus 5 repeats are kept.
